run_gcc_spec: run the Gcc class to query a GCC binary for its version, optimization flags, and parameter space
parse_gcc_optimize: parse the GCC optimization help output to extract all available -O and -f flag options
parse_gcc_params: parse the GCC param help output to extract all available --param options with their valid value ranges
create_gcc_flag_option: create a GccFlagOption instance to represent a boolean -f flag with on and off variants
fix_gcc_options: fix known GCC option parsing issues like invalid min values or renamed flags
